fidelity: F2a — Physics-Lumped Decay-Heat + Thermoelectric Module with Hot-Side Thermal ODE
source: Rowe, D.M. (1995/2006) CRC Handbook of Thermoelectrics; Bennett, G.L. (2006) Space Nuclear Power, AIAA 2006-4191; NASA GPHS-RTG / MMRTG specifications (rps.nasa.gov); El-Genk & Saber (2005) Energy Convers. Mgmt. 46(7-8) 1083

unit.name: GPHS-RTG (Pu-238, ~4.5kg fuel, SiGe unicouples — Voyager/Cassini/New Horizons class)

P_thermal_0_W.note: Initial (BOL) decay thermal power per GPHS-RTG ~4.5 kW

n_couples.note: Number of SiGe thermoelectric unicouples in GPHS-RTG

seebeck_couple.note: Effective Seebeck coefficient per couple (p+n SiGe), |S_p|+|S_n|; chosen with R,K so couple ZT=S^2*Tm/(R*K)=0.55

R_couple.note: Internal electrical resistance per SiGe couple

K_couple.note: Thermal conductance per couple (Fourier leg conduction); set so couple ZT=0.55 at T_mean=749 K: K=S^2*Tm/(R*ZT)

ZT.note: SiGe figure of merit ZT at mean operating temperature (~750-900 K)

T_hot_0_K.note: BOL hot-junction temperature from decay-heat/conduction balance (~650 C); fuel centerline runs hotter ~1273 K

C_hot_J_per_K.note: Lumped thermal capacitance of hot-side block (GPHS fuel + housing)

A_radiator_m2.note: Effective radiating fin area sized so Stefan-Boltzmann rejection at T_cold balances BOL cold-side heat Q_c (eps*sigma*A*T_c^4 = Q_c)

K_hot_to_cold_W_per_K.note: Parasitic structural/insulation conductance hot->cold bypassing couples

eta_teg_0.note: BOL system thermoelectric conversion efficiency ~4.2% (ZT-limited at this dT)
